title: Connect OptiSweep communication to UPS Chat to enable scan tunnel/tipper/sorter communication
summary: Verify that the OptiSweep system is connected to the UPS Chat communication layer (possibly previously called “chat XLE”), because OptiSweep must connect to this chat for communication with the scan tunnel and the tipper/sorter.
when_to_use: Use when scan tunnel, tote tipper/tote tip stations, or sorter interactions are not working as expected and you need to confirm the required upstream communication layer is connected: UPS Chat (chat XLE).
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for physical safety actions (e.g., E-stop).
Do not use this procedure if you cannot verify any live OptiSweep communication/configuration state related to UPS Chat; the source does not provide the exact OptiSweep UI fields to check.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Perform the live-system communication-layer verification to confirm OptiSweep is connected to UPS Chat for scan tunnel and tipper/sorter communication.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep software (live configuration/status view for the UPS Chat connection state; exact UI not provided in the source)

access_required: L2_support access to the OptiSweep environment needed to view/verify UPS Chat connection state (exact access method not provided in the source)
system_preconditions: OptiSweep is deployed and intended to integrate scan tunnel, tote tipper/tote tip stations, and sorter via the UPS Chat communication layer

visual_references.description: Overview core elements diagram showing UPS Chat and the components it connects to (scan tunnel, tote tipper/tote tip stations, sorter) and the statement that OptiSweep must connect to the chat.

steps.title: Identify the required building communication layer as UPS Chat (possibly “chat XLE”)
steps.purpose: Establish the exact communication layer name that OptiSweep must connect to for scan tunnel and tipper/sorter communication.
steps.instruction: In your live troubleshooting context, treat UPS Chat as the standard building communication layer used across UPS buildings (the source notes it may have been called “chat XLE”).
steps.expected_result: You can state the required upstream communication layer for this integration check as UPS Chat (chat XLE).
steps.healthy_condition: The troubleshooting target is clearly UPS Chat (not a downstream component like the scan tunnel or tipper alone).
steps.failure_condition: You attempt to troubleshoot only downstream components without confirming the required UPS Chat connection layer.

actions.label: Confirm communication layer name
actions.exact_action: Use UPS Chat as the standard communication layer (possibly previously called “chat XLE”).

source_evidence.quote: “UPS has a standard communication through all buildings… all the sorters talk the same way and it goes on to a chat… for us to communicate with the scan tunnel and the tipper or and the sorter, we have to connect to the chat… I don't know if it's used to be called chat XLE.”

steps.title: Verify OptiSweep is configured/connected to UPS Chat as the communication path
steps.purpose: Confirm the required integration path is actually connected in the live OptiSweep environment.
steps.instruction: In OptiSweep, check the live configuration/status that indicates the system is connected to UPS Chat (chat XLE) as the communication path used by the sorters for interactions involving the scan tunnel and the tipper/sorter.
steps.expected_result: You can verify from live OptiSweep configuration/status that OptiSweep is connected to UPS Chat.
steps.healthy_condition: Live OptiSweep state indicates an active/working connection to UPS Chat (exact UI fields are not provided in the source).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot verify that OptiSweep is connected to UPS Chat, or the live state indicates the UPS Chat connection is not established.

actions.label: Check UPS Chat connection state in OptiSweep
actions.exact_action: Verify OptiSweep is configured/connected to UPS Chat as the communication path used by the sorters.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot verify that OptiSweep is connected to UPS Chat, since the source states this connection is required for scan tunnel and tipper/sorter communication.

source_evidence.quote: “for us to communicate with the scan tunnel and the tipper or and the sorter, we have to connect to the chat”

steps.title: Confirm the UPS Chat path is intended to support scan tunnel and tipper/sorter interactions
steps.purpose: Ensure the verified connection is the one required for the specific subsystems mentioned by the source (scan tunnel, tipper, sorter).
steps.instruction: Use the live system context to confirm that the UPS Chat connection you verified is the one used for communication involving the scan tunnel and the tipper/sorter (as described by the source).
steps.expected_result: Your verification ties UPS Chat connectivity to scan tunnel and tipper/sorter communication needs.
steps.healthy_condition: The live integration context shows UPS Chat is the upstream communication layer for those components (exact live indicators not provided in the source).
steps.failure_condition: You verify a different communication path than UPS Chat, or you cannot connect the verified UPS Chat state to scan tunnel/tipper/sorter communication.

actions.label: Map UPS Chat to scan tunnel/tipper/sorter communication
actions.exact_action: Confirm the communication path is intended to support interactions with the scan tunnel and the tipper/sorter.

source_evidence.quote: “for us to communicate with the scan tunnel and the tipper or and the sorter, we have to connect to the chat”
Overview core elements includes UPS Chat, tote tipper/tote tip stations, Geek+ AGVs, hospital controller, OptiSweep software, sorter, and Aveva HMI; transcript also mentions scan tunnel.

steps.title: If communication is not working, narrow scope to the chat connection layer vs downstream components
steps.purpose: Reduce troubleshooting scope to the integration layer that the source identifies as required (UPS Chat), rather than assuming scan tunnel/tipper/sorter failures.
steps.instruction: If you determine UPS Chat connectivity is not established or cannot be verified, focus troubleshooting on the UPS Chat connection layer first, then only consider downstream components (scan tunnel, tote tip stations/tipper, sorter) after the chat connection is confirmed.
steps.expected_result: Troubleshooting focus is correctly narrowed to the UPS Chat connection layer when the required communication path is not verified.
steps.healthy_condition: You can distinguish whether the issue is upstream (UPS Chat connection) versus downstream (scan tunnel/tipper/sorter).
steps.failure_condition: You proceed directly to downstream component changes without first confirming UPS Chat connectivity.

actions.label: Narrow troubleshooting scope
actions.exact_action: Narrow scope to the chat connection layer versus downstream components (scan tunnel, tote tip stations/tipper, sorter).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot verify that OptiSweep is connected to UPS Chat.
